pages.title: Questionnaire · English / Română / Français
pages.description: Exact application wording · Source snapshot: 10 October 2026
paragraphs: This document contains all 81 current rating items, presented in the application’s section order, followed by its active participant prompts and answer options. The global numbers 1–81 are document references; IDs such as T1 and P13 are the stable application identifiers.

Question wording and translations are copied directly from the source code. They have not been rewritten, corrected or newly translated for this document. Explanatory headings and notes describe the current interface, not additional questions.

The rating scale remains 1–10. Students and medicine explorers complete the 81 ratings. Specialists may complete them or skip directly to the specialty interview. A contribution is stored for research only after the participant chooses the consent-and-save action.

The appendix includes participant role, specialist pathway, specialty selection, all 14 career-value choices, the optional student/explorer reflection, optional study year (1–6), five specialist interview questions and the conditional “why not” follow-up, plus optional geography fields.

Specialty and country dropdown catalogs are not reproduced: they are selection catalogs rather than questionnaire items, and the specialty catalog may be versioned separately. Deprecated experience/satisfaction questions and administration-only controls are not part of this questionnaire snapshot.

Source revision: 438cec22b3c92ee99772e263e18e38d4322fa0b4. Exact source-file SHA-256 hashes are included in the accompanying .source.json for reproducibility. This is a source snapshot, not a claim of questionnaire validation or a record of participant answers.

pages.title: A · Participant identification

text.fr: Qu’est-ce qui vous correspond ?

text.en: First, tell us who you are
text.fr: D’abord, indiquez-nous qui vous êtes

text.en: Choose your profile so the questionnaire follows the right path.
text.ro: Alege profilul tău pentru ca chestionarul să urmeze parcursul potrivit.
text.fr: Choisissez votre profil afin que le questionnaire suive le parcours adapté.
Je découvre la médecine

text.en: I'm curious about medicine and not yet sure whether I want to study it.
text.ro: Mă interesează medicina, dar nu știu încă dacă vreau să o studiez.
text.fr: La médecine m’intéresse, mais je ne sais pas encore si je souhaite l’étudier.
Étudiant

text.ro: Sunt student sau studentă la medicină.
text.fr: Je suis étudiant ou étudiante en médecine.
Spécialiste

text.en: I am a doctor or medical specialist.
text.fr: Je suis médecin ou spécialiste.

pages.note: The first line is the homepage reflection prompt. One role is selected before starting. Display order: exploring medicine, student, specialist.

pages.title: B · Specialist questionnaire pathway

text.en: How would you like to contribute?
text.fr: Comment souhaitez-vous contribuer ?

text.en: The 81-item questionnaire is optional for specialists. Complete it for quantitative calibration, or go directly to the five questions about your specialty.
text.ro: Chestionarul cu 81 de itemi este opțional pentru specialiști. Completează-l pentru calibrarea cantitativă sau mergi direct la cele cinci întrebări despre specialitatea ta.
text.fr: Le questionnaire de 81 items est facultatif pour les spécialistes. Remplissez-le pour contribuer à la calibration quantitative, ou allez directement aux cinq questions sur votre spécialité.
Répondre aux 81 items

text.en: About 8 minutes · Includes your personal specialty matches and quantitative calibration data.
text.ro: Aproximativ 8 minute · Include potrivirile tale de specialitate și date cantitative de calibrare.
text.fr: Environ 8 minutes · Inclut vos résultats d’adéquation et des données quantitatives de calibration.

text.en: Go directly to the specialist questions
text.ro: Merg direct la întrebările pentru specialiști
text.fr: Aller directement aux questions pour spécialistes

text.en: About 3 minutes · Share a qualitative contribution without completing the questionnaire.
text.ro: Aproximativ 3 minute · O contribuție calitativă, fără completarea chestionarului.
text.fr: Environ 3 minutes · Partagez une contribution qualitative sans remplir le questionnaire.

text.en: Whichever path you choose, data is stored only after you explicitly consent and submit. We do not ask for your name or email address.
text.ro: Indiferent de opțiunea aleasă, datele sunt stocate numai după ce îți exprimi explicit consimțământul și le trimiți. Nu îți solicităm numele sau adresa de e-mail.
text.fr: Quel que soit le parcours choisi, les données ne sont conservées qu’après votre consentement explicite et leur envoi. Nous ne demandons ni votre nom ni votre adresse e-mail.

pages.note: The specialist may skip all 81 ratings and career-value choices. The five-question specialty interview remains available.

pages.title: C · Specialty selection and career values

text.fr: Quelle spécialité vous attire ?

text.en: If a field already calls to you, pick it so you can see where it ranks. This choice does not change the score; skip it if nothing stands out yet.
text.ro: Dacă un domeniu te atrage deja, alege-l pentru a vedea unde se clasează. Alegerea nu modifică scorul; omite pasul dacă nimic nu iese încă în evidență.
text.fr: Si un domaine vous attire déjà, choisissez-le pour voir son rang. Ce choix ne modifie pas le score ; passez cette étape si rien ne se démarque encore.

text.en: Optional — pick one you're already drawn to.
text.ro: Opțional — alege una care te atrage deja.
text.fr: Optionnel — choisissez-en une qui vous attire déjà.
